decision_clocks: completed 10/15 minute post-settlement state and completed five-minute reclaim state
decision_templates: opposite-first move then causal funding-direction reclaim continuation
execution_rule: first later observable one-minute open; passive limit requires one-basis-point penetration
exits: structural target, structural stop or state loss only; no elapsed-time or scheduled close
information_unit: exact settled funding cash transfer notional plus causal post-settlement price/OI balance-sheet response
targets: nearest still-unconsumed prior UTC-day or confirmed four-hour external liquidity; one-hour targets rejected as scale-mismatched
transfer_stress: transfer_notional / prior-only median absolute five-minute OI-notional change
